### Element `r element`


#### Verschil in filtergrootte voor `r element` in functie van de concentratie

**Modelformule:**


```{r, results = 'asis'}
cat(paste(as.character(analysis_diff$formula)[c(2,1,3)], collapse  = " "), "\n")
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_diff$model_summary))
```

**Resultatentabel:**


```{r}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_diff$model_summary))
if (model_ok) {
  analysis_diff$model_summary$coefficients |>
  add_significance_stars() |>
  knitr::kable()
}
```

**Residueel plot:**


```{r}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_diff$model_summary))
if (model_ok){
  print(analysis_diff$plot_resid)
}
```

**Predictieplot:**

```{r}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_diff$model_summary))
if (model_ok){
  print(analysis_diff$plot_fit)
}

```


#### Analyse effect filtergroote op metingen van `r element`

**Modelformule:**


```{r, results = 'asis'}
cat(paste(as.character(analysis_fmod$formula)[c(2,1,3)], collapse  = " "), "\n")
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_fmod$model))
```

**Resultatentabel:**


```{r, results='asis'}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_fmod$model))
if (model_ok) {
   analysis_fmod$model$coefficients |>
    as.data.frame() |>
   add_significance_stars() |>
   knitr::kable()
}
```

**Residueel plot:**


```{r}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_fmod$model))
if (model_ok) {
  print(analysis_fmod$plot_resid)
}
```

**Predictieplot:**


```{r}
model_ok <- !all(is.na(analysis_fmod$model))
if (model_ok) {
  print(analysis_fmod$plot_pred)
}

```
